nessa.name: Nessa
nessa.title: Shore Caretaker
nessa.summary: A shipwreck survivor who became the encampment's caretaker.
nessa.story: Nessa is not a criminal exile — she is a shipwreck survivor who lost her family off the coast. She became the "mother" of the encampment, tending the sick. Act 6 Tragedy: Tsoagoth — The Brine King kidnaps Nessa, forcing her to become his "bride." She is fused with the Brine King, becoming a lure for victims.
nessa.flavorText: "The sea takes everything. But sometimes, it gives back." — Nessa

bestel.name: Bestel
bestel.title: The Mad Captain
bestel.summary: Captain of the Merry Gull, sole survivor after his crew was eaten by cannibals.
bestel.story: Captain of the Merry Gull, wrecked on Tidal Island. Crew devoured by cannibals — only Bestel survived. Known for terrible poetry and romance novel "Cedric and the Buxom Stranger."
bestel.flavorText: "The muse came to me on wings of rum and despair." — Bestel

silk.name: Silk
silk.title: The Boastful Hunter
silk.summary: A boastful hunter ultimately devoured by the Spider Goddess.
silk.story: Self-proclaimed great hunter, despised by Greust. Yeena believes truth hides in his stories. Act 7: Corrupted by Arakaali. Believes he'll marry the spider goddess. She devours him.
silk.flavorText: "Every good story begins with a lie." — Silk

eramir.name: Eramir
eramir.title: The Exiled Librarian
eramir.summary: Former Great Library librarian, most knowledgeable about Azmeri history.
eramir.story: Former librarian of Oriath's Great Library. Respected by the Azmeri tribe. Always suggests "throw dangerous artifacts in the river." Once knew The Shaper.
eramir.flavorText: "Knowledge is light. But too much light burns the eyes." — Eramir

hargan.name: Hargan
hargan.title: Black Market Dealer
hargan.summary: Oriathan merchant, expert of Sarn's underground.
hargan.story: Street-smart merchant. Never gives anything for free. Once smuggled someone who had an affair with Gravicius's wife — earning lifelong enmity.
hargan.flavorText: "Trust is a luxury. In Sarn, we only have deals." — Hargan

dialla.name: Lady Dialla
dialla.title: The Gemling Queen
dialla.summary: Transformed by Malachai into an immortal gem-human, 200+ years old.
dialla.story: Former mistress of Emperor Chitus, given to Malachai. He embedded Virtue Gems in her body. She refused to power the Rapture Device — causing partial Cataclysm instead of total destruction.
dialla.flavorText: "Not a cockroach. Not yet." — Lady Dialla

piety.name: Piety
piety.title: Thaumaturgy Sorceress
piety.summary: From prostitute to powerful sorceress, sacrificed fighting Malachai.
piety.story: Real name Vinia. Sentenced to burn for illegal thaumaturgy but Dominus spared her. Built lab in Lunaris Temple, created Miscreations. Later allied with Exile — killed by Malachai.
piety.flavorText: "Progress is not made by the many." — Piety

tasuni.name: Tasuni
tasuni.title: Blind Maraketh Seer
tasuni.summary: Born-blind seer who communicates with The Beast.
tasuni.story: Born blind, cast away by his tribe. Miraculously survived. Communicates with The Beast and The Nightmare. Irasha sees him as a dangerous manipulator who wants to become a god.
tasuni.flavorText: "I cannot see the light. But I see what the light hides." — Tasuni

dominus.name: High Templar Dominus
dominus.title: Tyrant of Oriath
dominus.summary: High Templar who exiled the player, obsessed with godhood.
dominus.story: Supreme authority of the Templar order. Exiled the player character. Commanded the Ebony Legion. Came to Wraeclast to experiment with Virtue Gems. Transforms into Dominus Ascendant when fought.
dominus.flavorText: "Order through strength. Strength through faith. Faith through me." — Dominus

sin_god.name: Sin
sin_god.title: God of Shadow — Unexpected Ally
sin_god.summary: Twin of Innocence, created The Beast, becomes the player's ally.
sin_god.story: Innocence vilified Sin to ascend — the "Original Sin." Sin created The Beast to imprison gods and free humanity. Guides the Exile through the Pantheon system. Sacrifices his power to help defeat Kitava.
sin_god.flavorText: "It is not a monster. It is a cage." — Sin, about The Beast

lilly.name: Lilly Roth
lilly.title: Pirate Entrepreneur
lilly.summary: Granddaughter of pirate Weylam Roth, provides transportation.
lilly.story: Granddaughter of Weylam Roth. Once dated Tarkleigh — tied him up and left when he wanted to settle, causing his exile. Provides ships for travel between Oriath and Wraeclast.
lilly.flavorText: "The sea is not a home. The sea is freedom." — Lilly Roth

lani.name: Lani
lani.title: Resistance Fighter
lani.summary: Oriathan fighter who gathered intelligence for the anti-Templar rebellion.
lani.story: Risked her life repeatedly gathering intelligence. Helped Exile escape Oriath. Knows about Kitava's cult and the "King's Feast" ritual. Shares a past with Lilly Roth.
lani.flavorText: "Freedom is not given. It is taken." — Lani
